title: Linking Words and Cohesion
ringkas: However, therefore, moreover, dan cara menyusun paragraf yang runtut
goals: memilih **kata penghubung** yang tepat untuk menambah, melawankan, menyebabkan, dan memberi contoh
memakai **tanda baca** yang benar dengan kata penghubung

lesson.text: Salah satu kriteria Writing dan Speaking adalah **Coherence and Cohesion**: gagasan harus mengalir dan terhubung. Kata penghubung (linking words) adalah alatnya. Namun, **tepat lebih penting daripada banyak**.

lesson.title: 1. Kata penghubung menurut fungsi
table: [[however, nevertheless, on the other hand, in contrast]]
[[because of, due to, therefore, as a result, consequently]]

lesson.title: 2. Tanda baca
table: [[Although it is expensive, many people buy it.]]
because of / due to + kata benda
[[Due to heavy rain, the match was cancelled.]]
[[The match was cancelled because it rained.]]

lesson.title: 3. Pasangan yang sering tertukar
table: [[Although he was tired, he kept working.]]
[[Because of the rain / Because it rained.]]
[[Despite being ill / Although he was ill.]]

lesson.title: Variasi, bukan hafalan
lesson.text: Pakai kata penghubung yang berbeda dan ketika memang ada hubungan makna. Menumpuk *Moreover* dan *Furthermore* di setiap kalimat membuat tulisan terkesan mekanis.

lesson.title: However bukan penghubung klausa
lesson.text: Jangan menyambung dua klausa dengan *however* dan koma saja. Salah: ~~It is cheap, however it is poor.~~ Benar: [[It is cheap; however, it is poor.]] atau [[It is cheap, but it is poor.]]

practice.q: Pilih kata penghubung yang menambah informasi: "Cars cause pollution. ___, they are expensive to maintain."
Pilih kata penghubung yang berlawanan: "Online learning is flexible. ___, it can feel lonely."
Pilih kata penghubung akibat: "The roads were flooded. ___, many schools closed."
Pilih kata penghubung contoh: "Some countries have strict laws. ___, Singapore bans chewing gum."
Pilih kata penghubung kesimpulan: "___, governments should invest in public transport."
Pilih kata yang tepat: "___ the heavy rain, the match continued."
Pilih kata yang tepat: "___ it was raining, the match continued."
Pilih kata yang tepat: "The match was cancelled ___ the heavy rain."
Pilih kata yang tepat: "The match was cancelled ___ it rained."
Pilih kata yang tepat: "Some people prefer cities, ___ others prefer villages."
Pilih kata yang tepat: "___, the project was a success." (secara keseluruhan)
Pilih kata yang tepat: "First, ... ___, ... Finally, ..."
Pilih kalimat dengan tanda baca yang benar:
options: It is cheap; however, it is poor.
It is cheap, however it is poor.
It is cheap however, it is poor.
It is cheap. however it is poor.

practice.q: Pilih kalimat yang benar:
options: Although he was tired, he kept working.
Although he was tired, but he kept working.
However he was tired, he kept working.
Despite he was tired, he kept working.

practice.q: Pilih kalimat yang SALAH:
options: Despite he was ill, he went to work.
Despite being ill, he went to work.
Although he was ill, he went to work.
In spite of his illness, he went to work.

practice.q: Pilih kalimat yang SALAH:
options: Because of it rained, the match stopped.
Because of the rain, the match stopped.
Because it rained, the match stopped.
Due to the rain, the match stopped.

practice.q: Pilih kata penghubung tambahan yang tepat: "Exercise improves health. ___, it reduces stress."
practice.exp: Menambah. Kalimat lengkap: **Exercise improves health. In addition, it reduces stress.**

practice.q: Pilih kata penghubung kontras: "Cities offer jobs. ___, villages offer peace."
practice.exp: Kontras. Kalimat lengkap: **Cities offer jobs. In contrast, villages offer peace.**

practice.q: Mana yang paling tepat untuk paragraf penutup?
Memakai Moreover dan Furthermore di setiap kalimat sebaiknya...
___, some people disagree.

practice.id: Penghubung akibat: The rain was heavy. ___ , the match stopped.
practice.q: The rain was heavy. ___, the match stopped.

practice.id: ___ the rain (bentuk kata benda), the match continued.
practice.q: ___ the rain, the match continued.
The match stopped ___ the rain.
Susun kalimat: "Namun, banyak orang tidak setuju."
practice.exp: Urutan yang benar: However, many people disagree.

practice.q: Susun kalimat: "Walaupun mahal, banyak orang membelinya."
practice.answer: Although it is expensive, many people buy it.
practice.exp: Urutan yang benar: Although it is expensive, many people buy it.

practice.q: Susun kalimat: "Karena hujan, pertandingan dibatalkan."
practice.answer: Because of the rain, the match was cancelled.
practice.exp: Urutan yang benar: Because of the rain, the match was cancelled.

read.title: Should Cities Ban Cars?
read.text:
Some people argue that cars should be banned from city centres. Firstly, cars cause pollution and noise. Moreover, they take up space that could be used for parks and cycle lanes. As a result, many European cities have created car-free zones.
However, a complete ban would create problems. Delivery vehicles need access to shops, and some residents cannot walk long distances. Therefore, many planners suggest a middle way: for example, charging cars an entry fee rather than forbidding them.
In conclusion, although banning cars has clear environmental benefits, a flexible approach is probably more realistic.
read.id:
Sebagian orang berpendapat mobil harus dilarang dari pusat kota. Pertama, mobil menyebabkan polusi dan kebisingan. Lagi pula, mobil memakan ruang yang bisa dipakai untuk taman dan jalur sepeda. Akibatnya, banyak kota di Eropa membuat zona bebas mobil.
Namun, larangan total akan menimbulkan masalah. Kendaraan pengantar butuh akses ke toko, dan sebagian warga tidak bisa berjalan jauh. Karena itu, banyak perencana menyarankan jalan tengah: misalnya, mengenakan biaya masuk kepada mobil alih-alih melarangnya.
Sebagai kesimpulan, meskipun melarang mobil punya manfaat lingkungan yang jelas, pendekatan yang fleksibel mungkin lebih realistis.

qs.q: Which word in the passage introduces an additional reason?
Which word introduces a contrast with the first paragraph?
Which phrase signals the result of car-free zones?

options: A flexible approach is more realistic.
